title: FewShotTabLLM — Few-Shot LLMs as Synthetic Tabular Data Generators
summary: A training-free framework that uses large language models with schema-enriched few-shot prompts to generate synthetic tabular data without dataset-specific fine-tuning. Its MCP server component also exposes a CTGAN-based generation service, wrapping SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata as an alternative synthesis tool callable by an AI agent.
